# AWS CodeCommit git hosting

**Status: proposed.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Extend the records-only CodeCommit control plane with git HTTP/SSH transport and repository storage.

## Proposed scope

- [ ] Git HTTP Smart Transfer protocol (/v1/repos/<name>/info/refs, git-upload-pack, git-receive-pack)
- [ ] SSH transport and public key management
- [ ] Branch management, default branch configuration, and commit APIs
- [ ] Trigger execution and CloudWatch Events integration
- [ ] Code package seeding for CloudFormation AWS::CodeCommit::Repository
